notablePrerequisites:
Resolute Monarch.
Marchesa does not have summoning sickness.
Divine Intervention has at least one intervention counter on it.
description:
Declare Marchesa as an attacker.
Marchesa's first ability triggers, removing all intervention counters from Divine Intervention.
Divine Intervention's second ability triggers, causing the game to end in a draw

uses.name: Invasion of Fiora // Marchesa, Resolute Monarch
